title: Incorrect increment of signature nonce
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  `ExecutionModule.executeBySig()` will `incrementSigNonce(accountOwner)` to increment the nonce for `accountOwner` to prevent replay attacks by ensuring each signature can only be used once.  However, it incorrectly increments the nonce for `accountOwner` even when the signer is not the `acccountOwner`.  This allows anyone to DoS the transactions of `accountOwner` or other valid signers, by incrementing the nonce by calling `executeBySig()`.
